title: Officer Jonah explains what God says about tattoos! #israelunitedinchrist #nathanyel7
cleanTitle: Officer Jonah explains what God says about tattoos!
segments: Shalom family, most high in Christ
bless. The topic today is tattoos. It's
being promoted at a high level. It's on
the rappers, all on their face. It's on
the basketball players. Is God okay with
it? Let's get a scripture. Leviticus
chapter 19 verse 28. You shall not make
any cuttings in your flesh for the dead.
So with tattoos, you got to cut your
flesh. God said don't do it.
Nor print any marks upon you. I am the
Lord. So God says don't print no marks
upon you. No marks. That's tattoos.
So guess what? If you already got
tattoos, once you hear this law,
repentance says don't get no more.
Shalom most high in Christ bless.
